comment: Optional town happenings (user request, Oct 29): each waits at a place during a window of day parts (many during class, so skipping pays off). Each is the only way to get its exclusive card (data/cards/town_exclusive_cards.json). 'hint' shows in the morning paper and the goal tracker. They play once per run.

stories.hint: Walt feeds the pigeons in the park (Tue and Thu, periods 1 and 2)

event.title: Pigeon hour
event.text: Walt is surrounded by about two hundred pigeons. They all turn to look at you at once.

choices.label: Help feed them
choices.result: The pigeons accept you. Walt says that's rare. 'They'll come if you need them,' he says, and you somehow believe him. (New card: Pigeon Swarm)

choices.label: Back away slowly
choices.result: Two hundred heads follow you out of the park.

stories.hint: Something rattles into the empty train station (Wed, period 2, from week 2)

event.title: The 10:15
event.text: At exactly 10:15 the old departure board flips by itself. A whistle sounds from nowhere. Amos goes very still.

choices.label: Check the platform
choices.result: On the platform: one yellowed ticket, punched thirty years ago, warm to the touch. (New card: Ghost Ticket)

choices.label: Stay with Amos
choices.result: 'Every Wednesday,' he whispers. 'Every single Wednesday.'

stories.hint: Lena tries a rail grind at the downtown bus stop (Mon and Fri, period 3)

event.title: Lena's rail
event.text: Lena has been trying to grind the bus stop railing for a week. 'Spot me?'

choices.label: Spot her
choices.result: She lands it. Then makes you try. You land something that is technically a trick. (New card: Kickflip)

choices.label: Film it
choices.result: The video gets eleven views. Nine are Lena.

stories.hint: A rival busker challenges Juniper on the square (Fri after school, Sat midday)

event.title: Busker's duel
event.text: A man with an accordion sets up ten feet from Juniper. This is war.

choices.label: Hype up Juniper (CHA)
choices.result: The crowd picks Juniper. She plays one last riff just for you and says you can keep it. (New card: Encore Riff)

choices.label: Throw a coin in both hats
choices.result: Diplomatic. Both of them glare at you.

stories.hint: Hank lost his keys somewhere in the school (Mon to Thu after school, from week 2)

event.title: Hank's keys
event.text: Hank is patting every pocket. 'Forty keys on that ring. If the wrong person finds it...'

choices.label: Help search
choices.result: You find the ring in the boiler room door. He gives you a spare: 'Opens most things. Don't open locker 113.' (New card: Master Key)

choices.label: Tell him you're busy
choices.result: He sighs and keeps patting pockets.

stories.hint: Rosa's rare flower stall at the Saturday morning market

event.title: The rare stall
event.text: Rosa has one bucket set apart from the rest. The flowers in it are pressed flat, and still somehow growing.

choices.label: Buy one ($8)
choices.result: 'Keep it close,' Rosa says. 'It remembers how to be alive.' (New card: Pressed Flower)

choices.label: Just look
choices.result: Rosa lets you smell one. It smells like next week.

stories.hint: High-score tournament at the arcade (Thu, period 3)

event.title: Midday tournament
event.text: The arcade is running a 'midday tournament', which is to say it's full of kids who should be in class.

choices.label: Enter
choices.result: You take first place. The prize is a laminated card with your initials. It feels heavier than it should. (New card: High Score)

choices.label: Watch
choices.result: Dex wins, then loses, then wins again. Nobody can explain the scoring.

stories.hint: Officer Pruitt takes her coffee break at Gary's Deli (Tue, period 2)

event.title: Coffee break
event.text: Officer Pruitt is at the counter with a coffee. She sees you. You see her. Gary pretends to see nothing.

choices.label: Sit down next to her
choices.result: She lets it slide. 'You remind me of me.' She leaves her spare whistle on the counter when she goes. (New card: Whistle Blast)

choices.label: Leave before she gets up
choices.result: You're out the door before the bell stops ringing.

stories.hint: The dry fountain hums after dark (weekend evenings, from week 3)

event.title: The fountain hums
event.text: The fountain hasn't run in thirty years. Tonight it hums, very softly, in a key that makes your teeth ache.

choices.label: Reach into the basin
choices.result: At the bottom: one coin, warm, with a face nobody's minted. (New card: Fountain Coin)

choices.label: Walk away
choices.result: The humming follows you to the corner, then stops.

stories.hint: Mo has a package for nobody at the post office (Mon, period 1)

event.title: Wrong delivery
event.text: Mo is holding a box addressed to '?' at '?'. 'Third one this month. You want to help me find where it goes?'

choices.label: Ride along
choices.result: It belongs to the abandoned lot. Mo shows you six shortcuts on the way. (New card: Shortcut)

choices.label: Not today
choices.result: Mo shrugs and puts it on the 'later' pile. The pile is enormous.

stories.hint: Ms. Marlowe's book sale at the library (Wed, period 3)

event.title: The book sale
event.text: The library's having a book sale. Ms. Marlowe has pulled one book off the cart and is holding it like it bit her.

choices.label: Ask about it
choices.result: 'Thirty years overdue,' she says. 'Returned last night. By nobody.' She lets you keep the notice. (New card: Overdue Notice)

choices.label: Browse the cart
choices.result: You buy a paperback about lighthouses for a quarter.

stories.hint: Mr. Ellis grades papers in the park (Fri, period 2, from week 2)

event.title: Pop quiz in the park
event.text: Mr. Ellis is grading quizzes on a bench. He looks up. 'You're not in my class. Want to take a quiz anyway?'

choices.label: Take it (INT)
choices.result: You get a B. He gives you his favourite trick question to keep. (New card: Pop Quiz)

choices.label: Pass
choices.result: 'Fair. I wouldn't either.'
